theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpi_pc_piece_orientation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (L : NNReal) (κ : ℝ) (H : Euclid n → Euclid P) (B : Set (Euclid n)), LipschitzWith L H → MeasurableSet B → 0 < κ → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, κ * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖H a - H a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ H a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ H a)) → ∃ η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n, StronglyMeasurable η ∧ (∀ u ∈ B, IsUnitOrientationOf (η (H u)) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ H u : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)) ∧ ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)))) * η (H u) α = α (fun a => fderiv ℝ H u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(μHE[n].restrict (H '' B)), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (H '' B) y Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η y) Q
